items.author: Newsroom
items.excerpt: The 7th International Women and Justice Summit in Istanbul ended on Nov. 22 with a closing declaration that treats pressure on women to meet beauty standards as a matter of justice. The two-day event, titled "Constructed Beauties" (Kurgulanmis Guzellikler), was organized by the Women and Democracy Foundation (KADEM) in cooperation with Türkiye's Ministry of Family and Social Services. It took place at the Ataturk Cultural Center (AKM). items.title: 23 deaths push Israeli troops' suicide rate to highest in 16 years
items.description: At least 23 active-duty Israeli soldiers and officers have died by suicide since the start of 2026, the highest annual figure in 16 years, Haaretz reported Monday. According to the...
items.author: Daily Sabah with AA
items.excerpt: At least 23 active-duty Israeli soldiers and officers have died by suicide since the start of 2026, the highest annual figure in 16 years, Haaretz reported Monday. According to the leading Israeli daily, among the dead were 17 soldiers who served in regular or reserve forces during the genocidal war on Gaza, They committed suicide this year after leaving active service. The figure also included five police officers who died by suicide in 2026. The tally points to a continued rise in suicides across Israel’s security establishment since the outbreak of the genocidal war on Gaza in October 2023.
